import pandas as pd

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_95/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'school_name'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'school_name' and calculate average math_score from Source1

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly

Target5_95["math_score"] = Target5_95["math_score"].astype(float)

# Save the result to the specified path

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_95/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_95/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Strip leading/trailing spaces in 'school_name' columns in both sources
source0['school_name'] = source0['school_name'].str.strip()
source1['school_name'] = source1['school_name'].str.strip()

# Join on 'school_name'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on='school_name', how='inner')

# Group by 'school_name' and aggregate average math_score
result = joined.groupby('school_name', as_index=False).agg({'math_score': 'mean'})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
